title: Save an estimate and finish it later

steps.caption: New estimate
steps.narration: Not ready to send an estimate yet? Save it as a draft, and finish it later.

steps.caption: Search for the client
steps.narration: Start a new estimate as usual. Search for the client,

steps.caption: Search the price book
steps.narration: Add the work you already know. Search your price book,

steps.caption: Title
steps.narration: Give it a title, so you can find it again.

steps.caption: Save as draft
steps.narration: Now, instead of Send estimate, choose Save as draft.

steps.caption: Saved
steps.narration: It is saved with its own number. Nothing has gone to the client.

steps.caption: Estimates
steps.narration: Later, come back to the Estimates page.

steps.caption: Draft filter
steps.narration: Tick Draft to list only your drafts.

steps.caption: Edit
steps.narration: Edit lets you change the lines, the title or the message.

steps.caption: Send
steps.narration: And when it is ready, choose Send.

steps.caption: Sent
steps.narration: Now it is sent, and this line shows when and to which address.

steps.caption: Where to find it
steps.narration: Your drafts are always under Estimates, in the left menu.

youtube.title: Save an estimate as a draft and send it later | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: Start an estimate in ConstructHUB CRM, save it as a draft instead of sending it, find it again with the Draft filter on the Estimates page, and send it when it is ready. The walkthrough uses a demo company and demo clients.
